quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Tim MacMahon's travel issues and plane delay
quotes.excerpt: McMahon flew back from the West Coast to Dallas and then they couldn't get the door

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: Joining us from Dallas, Texas, where he's just back. By the way, we had to delay here, Vince, as you know, because McMahon flew back from the West Coast to Dallas and then they couldn't get the door to the plane open.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: Howdy, partners. And then I get to the baggage carousel and I'm like, well, man, as long as we're parked at the gate, you'd think our bags would already be here. And I'm waiting for a while, and they say, by the way, even though it says your bag's supposed to be here, they're actually down this different carousel.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: He was banned from getting off the plane, Vince.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama's historic performance against the Mavericks
quotes.excerpt: Victor Wembanyama had 52 points, 24 rebounds, and 8 blocks in one of the most command performances
quotes.quote: Down in Texas on Wednesday night, Victor Wembanyama had 52 points, 24 rebounds, and 8 blocks in one of the most command performances we have seen in the recent NBA history. He was the first player to lead the whole league in blocks, rebounds, and points in the same night. There were 14 games being played on Wednesday night.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Historical context of Wembanyama's stat line
quotes.excerpt: My answer to the other question, which was 50 points, 20 rebounds, and at least five blocks
quotes.quote: My answer to the other question, which was 50 points, 20 rebounds, and at least five blocks since blocks became official, only been done by Bob McAdoo. So I'm going to go with Bob McAdoo.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Shaquille O'Neal's historical stat line comparison
quotes.excerpt: Shaquille O'Neal, 1993.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Wembanyama's dunking and physical dominance
quotes.excerpt: Wembanyama is dunking everything in sight. How many dunks does he have? Like 41 dunks?
quotes.quote: Wembanyama is dunking everything in sight. How many dunks does he have? Like 41 dunks? He had a 43-point game two or three games back. Wembanyama is dunking everything in sight.

quotes.speaker: Vincent Goodwill
quotes.summary_phrase: Critique of Wembanyama's shot selection and decision making
quotes.excerpt: Hopefully he's learned that lesson like letting Amen Thompson stuff you at the rim
quotes.quote: Hopefully he's learned that lesson like letting Amen Thompson stuff you at the rim for, you know, on a potential game winner when you have no business allowing. And now, don't get me wrong, Amen Thompson is one of the best athletes we've seen in the NBA in quite a long time. But if you keep the ball up high, there's not enough height, there's not enough space up there.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Wembanyama's physical toll and shot distribution
quotes.excerpt: He said after the game that the reason he's taking all these shots on the inside
quotes.quote: He said after the game that the reason he's taking all these shots on the inside. By the way, of the 16 baskets he made in this 52-point masterpiece, 13 of them were in the paint. Attacking the paint is also the reason why he went to the free throw line 20 some odd times.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Wembanyama's role as an interior force
quotes.excerpt: He needs to be a dominant big man who can also shoot threes instead of this seven-and-a-half-foot guard
quotes.quote: He needs to be a dominant big man who can also shoot threes instead of this seven-and-a-half-foot guard.

quotes.speaker: Vincent Goodwill
quotes.summary_phrase: The necessity of a five-out lineup for Wembanyama
quotes.excerpt: Nobody wins if you don't have a five-out lineup
quotes.quote: Nobody wins if you don't have a five-out lineup. It all makes sense for us to say, Victor, plant your seven-foot-four behind in the paint and stay there. You know what that means? You get beat up a lot. And for someone seven-foot-five, that means a strike zone. And a strike zone that large, that wide, whatever it is, means you're not going to get everything called in your favor.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Spurs' performance with and without Wembanyama
quotes.excerpt: They've got a net rating of plus 21.2 with Wembanyama on the floor
quotes.quote: They've got a net rating of plus 21.2 with Wembanyama on the floor, that goes to minus 14.7 when he's off the floor. That's about a 36-point swing, and Luke Kornet was a really good innings eater for them last year.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: 76ers' strong start and clutch performance
quotes.excerpt: The 76ers improved to 8 and 1 with a win in Vince's Detroit on Wednesday night
quotes.quote: The 76ers improved to 8 and 1 with a win in Vince's Detroit on Wednesday night, avenging their only loss of the season. They're now 4 and 0 on the road, and they're now 7 and 0 in games that go into clutch time. They have five great scorers and then you have Anthony Simons, who can be a great scorer. Not every night he's going to do it, but when he scores five, it doesn't crush your team.

quotes.speaker: Vincent Goodwill
quotes.summary_phrase: 76ers' pace and team dynamics
quotes.excerpt: How fast they play. And it doesn't show up like in pace, right?
quotes.quote: How fast they play. And it doesn't show up like in pace, right? Because I think they're like a middle of the road team in pace. But it's how quick they go into their actions, how quick they go from one thing to the next. And that's amazing to me when you're playing on a team with Joel Embiid.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James' return to Cleveland and team dynamics
quotes.excerpt: Friday, LeBron comes back to Cleveland. The Cavs are weezing a little bit
quotes.quote: Friday, LeBron comes back to Cleveland. The Cavs are weezing a little bit. They've lost two games in a row here to the Thunder, and you know, like the Cavs feel a certain way. They really thought LeBron was going to come back. And if LeBron was playing for any team in this league at $4 million a year, he would be an incredible value add.

quotes.speaker: Vincent Goodwill
quotes.summary_phrase: Critique of Kevin Durant's usage and team fit
quotes.excerpt: Kevin Durant is having career low usage, right? Stephen Curry is being carefully monitored
quotes.quote: Kevin Durant is having career low usage, right? Stephen Curry is being carefully monitored in how many games that he plays and the minutes that he plays and everything else. LeBron James thinks twice about going for breakaway dunks because he knows if I get the wrong type of collision, I'm going to be out two to four weeks.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander's performance and MVP potential
quotes.excerpt: Shai has been one of the most efficient players in the league for the last five years
quotes.quote: Shai has been one of the most efficient players in the league for the last five years. I believe five straight years of shooting over 50% from the field, which is incredible for a guard at his level. He doesn't take a ton of shots. That's why he he like never had a 40-point game for forever, even though he would have he would average 30 because he just didn't take that many shots.

quotes.speaker: Vincent Goodwill
quotes.summary_phrase: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander's physical intensity
quotes.excerpt: Game 7 against the Spurs was one of the first times that I actually saw him sweat
quotes.quote: Game 7 against the Spurs was one of the first times that I actually saw him sweat. Not actually not see him sweat like in how he plays, but actually see sweat, right? And like the man does not perspire. He's either he either doesn't perspire or that headband that he wears is the greatest absorbent material ever invented.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Kristaps Porzingis' status with the Warriors
quotes.excerpt: The Warriors ruled that Kristaps Porzingis has been withholding services and they ain't paying him
quotes.quote: The Warriors ruled that Kristaps Porzingis has been withholding services and they ain't paying him. And Porzingis is not challenging that quote-unquote ruling. Go ahead, go pay me.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Kristaps Porzingis' impact and health issues
quotes.excerpt: Kristaps Porzingis, who like can still impact games in the NBA, obviously health's been an issue
quotes.quote: Kristaps Porzingis, who like can still impact games in the NBA, obviously health's been an issue for forever, but when he's on the floor, he's still an effective player for the most part. And under contract for 20 million this year, and basically decides, and you know what, I don't want to play.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Kristaps Porzingis's impact on the Celtics' championship run
quotes.excerpt: He pretty much won them Game 1 and set the tone for the series.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: Kristaps Porzingis is coming off the bench and man, he had the best first half of his life in that series. Doing his thing where he's throwing in 28-footers, blocking shots, grabbing rebounds, just all over the place. And then I think he got hurt in Game 2 and didn't play the rest of the series.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: He pretty much won them Game 1 and set the tone for the series.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim Bontemps
text_blocks.text: Yeah, he set the tone for the series. No question.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: The bizarre trade situation surrounding Kristaps Porzingis
quotes.excerpt: They're not paying him, Porzingis is not fighting it, and they're still trying to trade him.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim Bontemps
text_blocks.text: I was at the Detroit airport yesterday when this news came out. In the report, Shams Charania is like, they're not paying him, Porzingis is not fighting it, and they're still trying to trade him. I was listening to these two guys sitting behind me and they were like, what do you mean? This is the NBA. What do you mean they're trying to trade him? So wait a minute, he's not playing, we're not paying him, but we're trying to trade him?

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: It actually increases his value in the trade market because now, not only is it a quasi-expiring contract, but you're going to get a discount because he'll take a buyout.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim Bontemps
text_blocks.text: Why would you take a buyout to pay him at all?

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: Or a buyout means you got to pay him some of the salary.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: A buyout means he got to show up. If he out here getting new teeth, then he ain't, I don't think he's showing up for nobody's physical.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Javelle McGee's release by the Shanghai Sharks
quotes.excerpt: Javelle McGee got let go by the Shanghai Sharks.
quotes.quote: This was disappointing. Did you guys see the news? Javelle McGee got let go by the Shanghai Sharks. For a little bit there, DeAndre Russell and Javelle McGee were running pick-and-roll for the Shanghai Sharks. It was like the god-awful Nico Mannion All-Star team over there.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: The bizarre nature of the Kristaps Porzingis trade contract
quotes.excerpt: It's an unbelievable get-out-of-jail-free card.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim Bontemps
text_blocks.text: I hope Porzingis is okay, but this is a bizarre situation to say the least. And that contract now becomes fast, you're saying it as a joke, but it's not a joke. It's a very fascinating trade chip. If he's not going to get, as far as I know, the contract still qualifies as, it's an unbelievable get-out-of-jail-free card.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: It's a really interesting thing because they're trying to be competitive during Steph's twilight, which Steph still obviously lighting it up. They're hoping to get Jimmy back mid-season, I don't know, February-ish. Jaxson is, if we're going to go on earlier awards discussion, certainly a Rookie of the Year candidate.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaxson Hayes as a key contributor for the Warriors
quotes.excerpt: Jaxson is a big-time contributor right now right away and a bridge to the future.
quotes.quote: Jaxson is a big-time contributor right now right away and a bridge to the future. And so as you've got this kind of get-out-of-jail-free trade chip, you got to be careful because there's two ways you can cash it in: take back bad money or attach picks to it. And so I think you still have to be careful of doing too much now and putting yourself in a real bad situation later.
